description: Codex: Orks (11e) DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS (Kult of Speed, 1 CP) from the S panel in the Orks' Movement phase. Setup brings two damaged ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of the Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies (a TRUKK unit): the Tankbustas (Boss Nob 1/3 W, one Tankbusta 1/2 W) and the Kommandos (two models destroyed); the Breaka Boyz, far away, are damaged too. The player opens the Stratagem panel, the row's Use button is enabled; a real click on Use opens the target picker; a real click on the Squigbuggies spends 1 CP and heals 3 wounds on EVERY ORKS INFANTRY unit within 3" (ruling: all eligible units, auto-selected) per 02.02.04: the Tankbustas regain all 3 lost wounds, the Kommandos get both destroyed models back with 1 wound each (the third heal has nothing left to restore). The Breaka Boyz are untouched. Setup-only privileges: Kult of Speed detachment (stratagems reloaded); units repositioned and wounded.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Kult of Speed; Tankbustas + Kommandos wounded within 3" of the Squigbuggies; Breaka Boyz wounded far away
r5:F12: the picker says which ORKS INFANTRY units the stratagem will heal (all within 3" are selected automatically)
